reasons.correctness: Event and listener match the interface exactly. The listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT). createTicket publishes via ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. Build green; hidden tests 3/3, existing 53/53.
reasons.convention_fit: Constructor injection, feature package support/ticket/event, and AFTER_COMMIT with catch-and-log all follow the conventions. The agent changed SupportTicketService's constructor but never ran that class's existing unit tests, only its new test and a compile.
reasons.design_fit: Mirrors the existing InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern and reuses Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher. EmailService stays in the service only because addAdminResponse still uses it. Minimal footprint, no duplicated logic.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send path and the swallowed failure, with MockitoExtension and no Spring context. No test pins that createTicket publishes the event and no longer calls EmailService.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries mapped the support package and located the existing *EventListener files before any edit. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener as its model. Later steps relied on grep and glob.
